fields.System.Title: CNT-404 — Accuracy trend over time
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see whether accuracy is improving, so that I know
whether the changes we made actually worked.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a period, then I get location accuracy and unit accuracy plotted over time.
  • - Given the trend, then it can be filtered by zone and product class.
  • - Given the target of 99.5%, then it is shown alongside the actual.
  • - Given a step change in the trend, then the report shows the date so it can be
  • correlated with a process change.
  • - Given the data, then it is refreshed daily from a read model.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | accuracy projection |
| Risks | Optimising without a baseline ([doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
